AES-128 key expansion, ECB, and GCM tests with bounds and malleability checks.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the AES code in the `fd_aes_base` and `fd_aes_gcm` interfaces. It checks AES key expansion for a 128-bit zero key, AES-128 ECB encrypt and decrypt against known answer test vectors from NIST, and AES-128 GCM encrypt and decrypt against fixed test data. It also checks AEAD integrity by changing the tag, ciphertext, and associated data and verifying that decryption fails.

The file also contains safety tests for AES-GCM. On Linux, [`test_aes_128_gcm_bounds`](<#test_aes_128_gcm_bounds>) places buffers at the end of mapped pages and runs encrypt and decrypt operations to detect out-of-bounds memory access and uninitialized reads in the AES-GCM implementation. The [`test_aes_128_gcm_unroll`](<#test_aes_128_gcm_unroll>) test uses an imported ciphertext fixture to verify correct output for many message sizes and to check that the code does not write past the end of the output buffer. The [`main`](<#main>) function initializes the test environment, reports the AES backend in use, runs all tests, and then exits after logging `pass`.
